governing_question: What is the most complete account of this black-box component, and what does it reply to the input word 'ab', which is absent from the given observations?
closure_assumption: The finite observation list is treated as the complete account of the component; this closure is WITHDRAWN, because a finite reply-word record does not fix the reply on an unattempted input word.
polar_view: Read the reply not as a lookup over seen words but as the output of a state-carrying process whose reply to the next symbol depends on the history so far; the seen words are consequences of one such process, and 'ab' is one more consequence to be produced by running it.
named_obstruction: A finite observed reply-word record underdetermines the reply on an unattempted input word, and may be reproduced by several inequivalent processes; only a candidate that yields a lawful prediction on the held-out word and survives its execution kills this obstruction.
